title: Spatiotemporal decoding of the pre-metastatic niche: Multi-omics innovations and clinical horizons.
snippet: Cancer metastasis, the leading cause of cancer mortality, is fundamentally dependent on the formation of a pre-metastatic niche (PMN), a distant microenvironment proactively reprogrammed by the primary tumor to support malignant seeding.
